title: AI Review Console
subtitle: Static decision console. Review cards, choose an action per card, export decision JSON. Nothing is changed from this page.
agent_note: Agents may rewrite this spec before generating the console. Keep actions concrete and review-safe. The `source` of each queue must match a key emitted by your deterministic data JSON.

queues.title: Pending decisions
queues.description: What is being decided and why it matters for this review.
queues.empty: Nothing to review in this queue.

actions.label: Close permanently
actions.description: Closes and archives the linked item; not easily reversed.

queues.title: Review backlog
queues.description: Optional second queue; add as many queues as the review needs.
